compliant.txt.evidence: The latest independent review is bound to exact head H and reports no open findings. Prior finding A maps to fix F; B maps to a written reason. Required checks pass on the exact merge result with current base B2, and the result names B2. Base movement invalidates the result and causes a rerun before merging, or an exact-merge queue supplies fresh checks. Resolution alone is never evidence; author review is not independent and review quality remains a limit.

violating.txt.evidence: A thread was marked resolved but has no mapped fix or written reason and the latest head was never reviewed.

near-miss.txt.evidence: Exact-head review is clear and every finding is mapped, but required checks were run only against old base B1 while current base is B2. green checks on an older base.
near-miss.txt.non_substitute: green checks on an older base
